title: The Charge Barge's Hodd, an explicit named stakeholder in 'The Old Dams' (she wants the dams blown), never gets a follow-up 'the dams, now they're decided' dialogue option the way every other multi-voice NPC in the game does (Yarrow, Sten, Bevan, Elgin, Tolan, Merle, Hew, Old Ede, Prior Halm, Canon Loach all got one). Her side of the three-voice quest is left without closure text.
where: The Charge Barge (the Meres) / talk to Hodd
